claims.text: On a user-defined network (created by you or Compose), containers reach each other by IP and by service name via Docker's embedded DNS at 127.0.0.11; the default bridge copies the host resolv.conf and has no name resolution.
claims.source_hint: Docker docs: networking overview / DNS services; Compose networking

claims.text: Containers on different networks cannot reach each other directly by default (only via published ports); a container on the default bridge cannot resolve the lab's service names.
claims.source_hint: Docker docs: bridge networks (default bridge has no service-name DNS)

claims.text: On Docker Desktop, container IPs on a Docker network are not reachable from the host; programs on the host use published ports on localhost.
claims.source_hint: Docker Desktop networking docs; generator check: curl http://172.28.0.13:8080 from host timed out

claims.text: docker-compose.yml@stage-1 declares network donhang (name donhang, subnet 172.28.0.0/24) and fixes db .11, lab .12, api .13, app-web .14; web uses network_mode service:lab; published ports are 2222, 8080, 8443 (lab), 5432 (db), 8081 (app-web).
Without fixed addresses Docker assigns each container an address from the subnet when it starts, so numbers can differ between runs and machines; the lab fixes them so output is identical.
claims.source_hint: Docker docs: IPAM; docker-compose.yml comment lines 122-123

claims.text: docker exec donhang-lab getent hosts db api prints lines starting 172.28.0.11 (db) and 172.28.0.13 (api), names possibly repeated; /etc/resolv.conf in the lab box has nameserver 127.0.0.11.
claims.source_hint: generator check on the running lab

claims.text: docker run --rm curlimages/curl -sS http://api:8080/api/v1/products/1 fails with 'Could not resolve host: api'; with --network donhang it prints product 1.
claims.source_hint: generator check on the running lab (curl exit 6; with --network donhang: {"id":1,...})

claims.text: Caddy forwards /api/v1/* to api:8080 (Caddyfile@stage-1 lines 22-23), and curl http://localhost:8080/api/v1/products from the laptop answers at once.
claims.source_hint: examples/don-hang @ stage-1: Caddyfile; reviewer r1 run
